# chromatogram: `ChromatogramOutput`

The `data` payload of `openreadout analyze chromatogram FILE --json` (`--tic`, `--bpc`, `--mz M`, `--transition Q1>Q3`, `--trace N`), inside the [envelope](envelope.md).

Output of `analyze chromatogram`.

JSON Schema: [`docs/schema/chromatogram.schema.json`](https://github.com/openreadout/openreadout/blob/main/docs/schema/chromatogram.schema.json) · also printed by `openreadout self schema chromatogram`.

## Fields

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | `string` | yes | The input file. |
| `format` | `string` | yes | Format id of the input file. |
| `run` | `integer` (uint32) or `null` |  | Spectra run used, when any chromatogram was computed from spectra. |
| `spectra_read` | `integer` (uint64) | yes | Spectra decoded. |
| `chromatograms` | array of [`Chromatogram`](#chromatogram) | yes | One entry per requested chromatogram. |
| `output` | `string` or `null` |  | File written (`-o`), when any. |
| `notes` | array of `string` |  | Anything the caller should know. |

## Types

### Chromatogram

One chromatogram: retention times (minutes) and intensities, with how they were obtained
and a summary.

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string` | yes | Short label, e.g. `TIC`, `XIC 301.1410 ±10 ppm`, `SRM 279.2 > 179.2`, `DAD1 A`. |
| `kind` | `string` | yes | `tic`, `bpc`, `xic`, `srm` or `trace`. |
| `source` | `string` | yes | Where the points come from: `spectra` (computed from the mass spectra), `trace N` (a stored chromatogram or detector signal) or `table N` (an MRM table column). |
| `mz` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | XIC target m/z. |
| `mz_window` | array of 2 × `number` (double) or `null` |  | XIC window `[low, high]` m/z. |
| `mz_range` | array of 2 × `number` (double) or `null` |  | TIC/BPC m/z range. |
| `precursor_mz` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | SRM: the precursor (Q1) m/z matched in the file. |
| `product_mz` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | SRM: the product (Q3) m/z matched in the file. |
| `ms_level` | `integer` (uint32) or `null` |  | MS level of the scans used. |
| `polarity` | `string` or `null` |  | Polarity filter applied. |
| `scan_filter` | `string` or `null` |  | Scan-filter text required. |
| `aggregation` | `string` or `null` |  | `sum` or `max` (XIC). |
| `centroid_scans` | `integer` (uint64) or `null` |  | Scans read as centroids. |
| `profile_scans` | `integer` (uint64) or `null` |  | Scans read as profiles (their points inside the window are summed). |
| `intensity_source` | `string` or `null` |  | TIC/BPC: points from the scan's recorded value (`recorded`), from its points (`computed`), or both (`mixed`). |
| `intensity_unit` | `string` or `null` |  | Unit of `intensity` (`counts` for mass spectra, the detector's unit for traces). |
| `points` | `integer` (uint64) | yes | Points in the chromatogram. |
| `apex_rt_min` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | Retention time of the most intense point, minutes. |
| `apex_intensity` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | Intensity of the most intense point. |
| `integral` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | Trapezoidal integral of the whole chromatogram (no baseline), intensity × minutes. |
| `rt_min` | array of `number` (double) | yes | Retention times, minutes (ascending). |
| `intensity` | array of `number` (double) | yes | Intensities. |
| `decimated` | `boolean` |  | True when `rt_min`/`intensity` were thinned to `max_points` (the most intense point of each of `max_points` equal slices is kept); the summary covers every point. |
| `notes` | array of `string` |  | Anything the caller should know. |
